verdict.rationale: kitty documents scripted control of the terminal, and a hands-on probe launched it detached with remote control enabled. That probe then drove a full send-text/get-text/close loop through `kitten @`, so non-interactive automation of kitty itself is verified. The evidence never shows kitty running without a display or inside a CI pipeline; the probe ran against a live window. missing for 10: documented headless/no-display mode, evidence of running in CI environments, independent corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: kitty can be controlled from scripts or the shell prompt. You can open new windows, send arbitrary text input to any window, change the title of windows and tabs, etc.
launched `kitty --detach -o allow_remote_control=socket-only --listen-on unix:/tmp/...`; `kitten @ ls` returned full window/tab/layout state as JSON
